shifted_malcev.heisenberg_dictionary: -A floor(B+lambda) mod 1 is the vertical Mal'cev coordinate of g_lambda = ((A, B+lambda, 0))

identity_section.leibman_character: k1 A + k2 B in Z is a linear form; A^2 - (9/4) B = 0 is a real parabola and is not a horizontal character
identity_section.reason: the parabola is consumed by making AB a Hardy monomial; it does not close the horizontal torus and does not pin the identity section among center fibers

i.jj: no second averaging variable; family averages (block index, mu_0, k-family) re-enter BB/GG/CC
i.heisenberg: integration over lambda is Haar on the center (y-circle before reduction); pinning lambda = 0 is pinning the identity section. No new lattice direction appears: amplitude separation still forces A(p) ~ A(q) to imply p = q. Named family averages stay forbidden and are not retested

ii.jj: concentration inverse for A{B} is sum e(j A {B}) — the same class at amplitude j A
ii.heisenberg: a Fourier mode j of the vertical Mal'cev coordinate is the orbit at amplitude j A; the class is closed under its own inverse theory on the nilmanifold too

iii.jj: |dS/dlambda| <= 2 pi A_max L; decorrelation at 1/A_max ~ P^{-27/16}
iii.heisenberg: y-translation deposits -A lambda in the center; the translation speed is A, so the correlation length on the center circle is 1/A — the same scale, not a new one

decision.notes: the Heisenberg lift is a dictionary for the Proposition 7.4 shift; JJ (i)-(iii) survive; lambda = 0 is a free center fiber; Conjectures V/HH stay PARKED
